name: Z Mogao-Caves 3x3 (Magnetic)
description: Z Mogao-Caves 3x3 (Magnetic) is a beautiful, decorative 3x3 speed cube featuring patterns inspired by the Chinese Mogao-Caves. This cube is gold plated, so the turning and solving experience is spectacular!
features: Faster, more accurate turning that “clicks” into place.
Small magnets installed inside edge and corner pieces.
